SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') AS time, SUM(current_stock) AS stockCount FROM spare_stock
deleted = 0
AND create_time BETWEEN #{timeRange[0]} AND #{timeRange[1]}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') ORDER BY time

SELECT spare_name AS spareName, SUM(current_stock) AS currentStock FROM spare_stock
deleted = 0
AND create_time BETWEEN #{timeRange[0]} AND #{timeRange[1]}
GROUP BY spare_id, spare_name ORDER BY currentStock DESC
SELECT DISTINCT spare_id AS spareId, spare_name AS spareName FROM spare_stock WHERE deleted = 0 AND spare_id IS NOT NULL AND spare_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY spare_name ASC
